plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid from others, bidding your value either wins you a positive profit (if your value is higher than the second-highest bid) or avoids a loss (if your value is lower). Since this is round 1 of 1, there is no history to learn from. Therefore, I will bid my value of $49.

The dominant strategy in a second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you only pay the second-highest bid, so there's no downside to bidding truthfully. Bidding less risks losing the item even if it's worth more to you, and bidding more doesn't change the amount you pay if you win. My value is $44, so I will bid $44.
